naming_instructions: The name must be concise: 2 to 5 words, lowercase, separated by hyphens. Keep only what identifies the file: the main subject plus the key company, person or document type. Add a date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) only when it is what tells similar files apart, such as invoices or statements. Never use filler words such as document, file, final, copy, version, scan or untitled. Examples: acme-invoice-2026-10, raitio-system-requirements, oss-convertible-note-summary.
